body_html:
@petermolnar That is my thinking. I am starting a HWC with my local chamber of commerce to focus on "facebook only" local businesses and going to spin one up with out Computer Science club at @SCSU in New Haven for students

In terms of my open source contribution I focus a lot on leadership development development and ensuring pathways of participation or writing documentation so it doesn't look like it was written by devs. Mainly just been contributing to @mozilla last eight years, but done some work #openbadges and @creativecommons as well
